name: You are given a Hamiltonian describing a quantum spin chain with 4 qubits: H = Z
task_prompt: You are given a Hamiltonian describing a quantum spin chain with 4 qubits: H = Z_0 Z_1 + X_0 X_2 + Y_1 Y_3. Using PennyLane 0.44.1, write a Python function that: (1) Defines a variational quantum circuit ansatz using 6 trainable parameters (rotations on each qubit followed by two CNOT entangling layers); (2) Computes the expectation value of H using qml.Hamiltonian and qml.expval; (3) Uses gradient descent to minimize the expectation value (cost function). Provide the complete code that would be syntactically correct, import-ready, and can be run on default.qubit.
